description: This file defines the UserPasswordForm class for handling user password reset forms in Drupal, including form building, validation, and submission logic.

classes.name: UserPasswordForm
classes.description: A form class for handling user password reset requests, including form display, validation, and processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as user storage, language manager, config factory, flood service, username validator, and email validator.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the password reset form with username/email input and instructions.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates form input, checks flood control, validates username/email, and loads user account.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, sends password reset email if account is valid, and logs the event.
